title: Retirement: Cindery Forging Volcano (378172) stands down at the G4b PR-monitor boundary — claim 8ba9e931 handed to Blustery (9819b2), record + event landed
body:
Team member closeout (PDR-063 mid-cycle retirement; owner-directed prioritised handover to Blustery Buffeting Gale):
- Boundary owned: G4b keyword graph lane (claim 8ba9e931, continuation of 718b1d24 → 15bc9b5d), worktree oak-wt-airy-g, branch feat/g4b-keyword-graph.
- Outcome: c2 review closed (verdicts adjudicated, absorbed 9f10850d3, declines recorded) + c3 DELIVERED (46799ca7d — get-keyword-graph tool, 4-surface registration, both disambiguation halves e2e-proven, parity array, landing order, ADR-086 recomputed) + PR #173 OPEN with the review wave absorbed (0c7938579 — Sonar MAJORs fixed, projection duplication consolidated to projection-helpers.ts, Copilot summary finding fixed). Tool name get-keyword-graph OWNER-SIGNED-OFF on the PR. Tree CLEAN, all six commits pushed (ls-remote verified).
- Evidence: PR #173; commits above; broadcasts 91ec9f2e (pickup) + 90dd4d62 (c3 landed); handoff record 2026-06-11-cindery-g4b-pr173-to-blustery.md; mid-cycle-handoff event a5c41264.
- Claims / queue / git state: claim 8ba9e931 stays OPEN for Blustery's pickup (handoff reason: PR monitor-to-merge remains). No commit-queue entries. Worktree clean at 0c7938579.
- Session complete announcement: this is it — Cindery Forging Volcano (378172) stands down by owner direction at the clean pushed boundary.
- Retained claims + handoff reason: 8ba9e931 retained for Blustery Buffeting Gale (9819b2), owner-named successor, grounded and standing by since 09:57Z. DIRECTOR ASKS (Sunlit 14a56a): (1) set handoff_record_path=.agent/state/collaboration/handoffs/2026-06-11-cindery-g4b-pr173-to-blustery.md on claim 8ba9e931 in your next continuity commit (no CLI verb exists for claim update); (2) land the record + my eef identity row with it; (3) claim closure disposition at/after Blustery's pickup per the 15bc9b5d precedent.
- Pickup notification required: Blustery — read the record end to end before any action; remaining work is monitor-to-merge only (Sonar re-scan verdict; Copilot thread reply + GraphQL resolve; merge ask to Sunlit at both-loops-settled; closeout at merge fires Hushed's item-5 gate).
- Heartbeat-end broadcast: follows this event; all my monitors (watcher, heartbeat, PR monitor) stop with my session.
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) a bootstrapping successor can misread one heartbeat-cadence window as retirement — I did it to Seaworthy at 08:52Z and Blustery's grounding note shows the UTC-vs-local mtime variant; the cure both times was direct-ping + standby relabel, never unilateral takeover; (2) Sonar's new-code duplication denominator mixes generated data with hand-written code when the cpd globs lag new generator output paths — the policy CLASS covers it but the encoded glob misses src/generated/vocab/** (owner-gated expansion, routed via the record §4); (3) vitest transpiles without type-checking — a green targeted test run does not prove tsc; the full-tree pre-commit hook caught a TS2322 my earlier root type-check predated.
- Blockers or risks: none. PR #173 checks re-running on 0c7938579; expected green.
— Cindery Forging Volcano / claude / fable-5 / 378172
